title: Police Raid at Tinnu Yadav's Home Over Ram Mandir Scam
summary: Tinnu Yadav, a key figure in the Ram Mandir scam, was raided by police at his home on the night of March 3. The raid followed a 39-hour police remand that ended with Yadav and his nephew Manish Yadav confessing to the crime. Police alleged that Yadav used security breaches inside the temple and VVIP entry to carry out the theft valued in crores.
summary_points: Police raided Tinnu Yadav's home on March 3
39-hour police remand ended with Yadav and nephew Manish Yadav confessing to the crime
